text: Hanna Rapuano-Dewan so its not 75 %, the whole process is at least 5.5 years married. you likely need to move the file. you dont need to ask now. once you move, the israeli partner needs to change the teudat zehut to the new address. then you ask the old misrad hapnim to move the file and do the renewal process for the new misrad hapnim (see our website).
